description: Its 'good' verdict is provisional until the Elixir side is as fast as we can make it. Ideas: Separable blur (horizontal then vertical), three-row binary walking instead of 9 :binary.at/2 reads per pixel, output as iodata. Record alternatives tried; set baseline: :optimized. If Elixir comes within 2x, the verdict becomes marginal and Elixir is the recommendation: record that as a result.
title: Optimise the Elixir baseline: image_blur
